title: Repair macOS Metal and Gallery for development
requires: Physical Apple M4 macOS Metal hardware, current Slang/Metal toolchain and the exact F8-28 candidate-v9 failure archive
scope: Repair the candidate-v9 macOS Metal rope-finalizer binding and shared Gallery reset/lifetime failures, retaining the implementation and evidence in PR 639. Apply docs/roadmap/PHYSICS-QUALITY-DEVELOPMENT.md: this bounded adapter/Gallery repair establishes a working development base and can merge with affected correctness, lifecycle and solver-work checks passing. Preserve shared Slang physics results, one 1/60-second advance, one spatial publication, all existing solver-work budgets, API behavior and capability coverage. Record aggregate performance misses and negative-control baseline failures honestly; their full qualification is a later release milestone, not this repair's development merge gate. No task becomes complete solely because its gate was replanned. Candidate-v9 and earlier repaired-source captures remain separate immutable history.
acceptance: Retain hash-bound reproduction of the historical rope-finalizer binding and reset/lifetime failures. Prove the rope finalizer is a D3D12-only no-op on Metal and repair that adapter contract deliberately; do not ignore arbitrary optimized-away arguments.

Metal rope, rope-fluid, rope-soft-body, rope-cloth and smoke-rope execute through normal public creation without device loss. Preserve the shared physics result, one 1/60-second advance, one spatial publication and every existing iteration/dispatch/submission/readback/synchronization budget; no backend physics fork or hidden retry.

Desktop/mobile reset semantics and command-resource retirement agree with shared Gallery and validation contracts. A clean Release macOS preset passes affected native, transport, realtime, Gallery, mobile-session, lifecycle, completion-wait and installed-app tests, with unsupported skips identified.

Verify the canonical /Applications Gallery revision, Metal backend, signature and Dock target. All 30 installed public cases per mode execute successfully. Retain the complete 12-scenario capture and evaluate affected physical, numerical, work and recovery checks independently of aggregate timing. A genuine correctness or work-budget failure remains blocking.

Retain exact source/tree, device/toolchain, installed binary/manifest, generated Metal/reflection, raw timings and before/after evidence. Report both workload modes, all stalls and negative-control results. A timing-failed baseline does not count as a negative-control pass. The unchanged whole-project 10 ms/16.667 ms targets are reported outstanding when missed; they do not block this development repair.

Compare all F8-70 protected closures and clearly label this as development repair acceptance, not final physics/performance or multi-device qualification. Keep the original passing ffdafab7 capture and failed integrated-source capture separate; F8-74 requires its own future source freeze and appropriate qualification.
